# New York Hoops Academy

> > Premier youth basketball training and development programs across Brooklyn with expert coaching, competitive leagues, and multi-level skill instruction.

New York Hoops Academy operates multiple locations throughout Brooklyn and Long Island, offering comprehensive basketball programs for youth ranging from recreational to competitive AAU travel teams. The academy combines professional coaching, facility rentals, and school-based after-school programs to serve the local basketball community.

## Key Topics

- Youth Basketball
- Brooklyn Locations
- AAU Travel Teams
- Summer Camps
- After-School Programs
- Development League
- Skill Development
- Hoops Klub Court Rental
- Expert Coaching
- Competitive Leagues
- Multi-Age Programs
- School Partnerships
- Seasonal Training

## Core Programs

- [Programs & Services Overview](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer): Complete overview of basketball programs including summer camps, travel teams, and after-school instruction.
- [Basketball Classes & Development League](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/classes): Youth basketball classes and competitive development league games in Brooklyn.
- [Summer Camp Experience](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/summer-camp): Multi-sport summer camp program with athletic development for kids and teens.
- [AAU Travel Team](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/travel-team): Competitive AAU travel team program for serious youth basketball athletes.
- [Parent & Child Program](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/parent-player): 12-week seasonal parent-child basketball program for bonding and skill building.

## Locations

- [Downtown Brooklyn Academy](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/locations/hoops-academy-nyc): Main location featuring development league and after-school programs in Downtown Brooklyn.
- [Williamsburg Basketball Academy](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/locations/hoops-basketball-academy-williamsburg): Williamsburg location offering youth basketball and summer camp programs.
- [South Brooklyn Academy](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/locations/hoops-basketball-academy-brooklyn): South Brooklyn facility for youth basketball skill development programs.
- [Roosevelt Island Location](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/locations/roosevelt-island): Roosevelt Island basketball programs serving ages 5-10.
- [Hoops Klub Court Rental](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/hoops-klub): Public basketball court rental facility in Brooklyn available for all skill levels.

## After-School Programs

- [After-School Programs Overview](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/after-school): After-school basketball programs across multiple Brooklyn schools with skill development focus.
- [Arbor Elementary School Program](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/after-school/arbor-elementary-school): Arbor Elementary after-school basketball with complimentary pickup service.
- [Brooklyn Prospect Downtown Program](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/after-school/brooklyn-prospect-downtown): Brooklyn Prospect Downtown after-school basketball skill-building curriculum.
- [Community Roots Program](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/after-school/community-roots-afterschool-info): Community Roots after-school basketball emphasizing teamwork and skill development.
- [IES After-School Program](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/after-school/ies-afterschool-info): IES after-school basketball with skill development and scrimmage opportunities.

## Competitive Play

- [Youth Leagues & Registration](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/leagues): Hoops Youth League registration and competitive schedule in Downtown Brooklyn.
- [Development Program Details](https://newyorkhoopsacademy.com/we-offer/classes/hoops-academy-development-program-details): Detailed information on development program with practice locations and seasonal schedule.
